Project Features :

Located just off Sheikh Zayed Road, Al Zarouni Business Centre offers fitted office spaces ideal for SMEs and professional firms. It’s within walking distance to Mall of the Emirates Metro, ensuring easy access for staff and clients. The building features ready-to-use offices, retail units, covered parking, and 24/7 security—making it a practical, well-connected choice for commercial use in central Dubai.

About the Community :

Al Barsha 1 is a central, mixed-use district known for its blend of residential, retail, and commercial developments. Located near Sheikh Zayed Road and home to Mall of the Emirates, it offers excellent transport links via metro and major roads. The area attracts businesses for its accessibility, amenities, and vibrant foot traffic—making it a strategic choice for offices, clinics, and retail operations.
